lines.zh: 四条腿撑着，肚子贴着泥。
lines.en: Four legs carry me with my belly to the mud.

lines.zh: 我拖着肚子，从淤泥里趟过去。
lines.en: I haul my belly through the silt.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖着，在泥上画一道沟。
lines.en: My tail drags a groove through the mud.
I walk with my mouth hanging open.

lines.zh: 我陷进软泥里，又拔出来。
lines.en: I sink in the soft mud and pull free.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面走，只露出眼。
lines.en: I move at the surface with only my eyes out.
Step by step, slow and heavy.

lines.zh: 我把芦苇压平，直接过去。
lines.en: I flatten the reeds and go straight through.

lines.zh: 我呼出一口气，水面起了波纹。
lines.en: I exhale and rings spread on the water.
Weeds hang off my back.
I shift toward deeper water.

lines.zh: 我的脚爪在泥里留下四个洞。
lines.en: My claws leave four holes in the mud.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，把头低下去。
lines.en: I pause and lower my head.
I slide past a floating log.

lines.zh: 我懒得快，快也追不上什么。
lines.en: I can't be bothered to hurry; hurrying catches nothing.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里走，几乎不出声。
lines.en: I move through the shallows almost silently.

lines.zh: 前面有片干的滩，我上去。
lines.en: There's a dry bank ahead; I climb out.

lines.zh: 太阳晒着背，我身上还滴着水。
lines.en: Sun on my back while water still drips off me.
I lie with my mouth wide open.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一根浮木。
lines.en: Motionless, I look like a floating log.
Only my eyes move.
The bugs on the water I ignore.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把嘴合上，又张开。
lines.en: I close my jaws slowly, then open them.
Mud has half buried me.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸让水面起小波。
lines.en: My breathing puts small ripples on the water.
I'm waiting to soak up the sun.
A bird lands on my back.
I watch it without moving.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴尖在水里轻轻摆。
lines.en: My tail tip sways gently in the water.
I rest my head on the bank.
Nobody's come here in a long while.

lines.zh: 我嘴里含着的水慢慢漏掉。
lines.en: The water held in my mouth drains slowly.
You're standing at the water's edge, quite close.
I only turn my head.

lines.zh: 你看了看我，以为是根木头。
lines.en: You looked at me and took me for a log.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在泥上，看你。
lines.en: I rest my jaw on the mud and watch you.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上不敢下来，对的。
lines.en: You're staying up on the bank. Right.
I won't come ashore unless I must.

lines.zh: 别再往前，那是我的水边。
lines.en: Not a step further — that's my bank.
I sink back a little into the water.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的背上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my back.

lines.zh: 我在水里，你在岸上，这样很好。
lines.en: Me in the water, you on the bank — that's fine.

lines.zh: 我猛地一甩头，退了很远。
lines.en: I whip my head round and back off far.

lines.zh: 我背上的硬皮裂开一道。
lines.en: A crack opens in the hard hide on my back.

lines.zh: 我猛地一缩，撞翻了身后芦苇。
lines.en: I jerk back and knock over the reeds behind me.

lines.zh: 我沉进泥里，让伤口凉下来。
lines.en: I sink into the mud to cool the wound.
I sink until only my eyes show.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，发出很低的一声。
lines.en: I open my jaws and let out a low sound.
I flatten into the mud and hold.
It hurts, but I can still bite.

lines.zh: 这一口，我记在你身上了。
lines.en: I'll remember this bite on you.
I retreat slowly into deeper water.
Meat smell, on the bank.
I swim slowly toward it.

lines.zh: 血还是温的，我能闻出来。
lines.en: The blood is still warm; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 别举着，放到我够得着的地方。
lines.en: Don't hold it up; put it where I can reach.
Mouth open, I wait for it to slide down.
I bite and hold.

lines.zh: 这点肉，连一条鱼都不如。
lines.en: This scrap isn't even worth one fish.
This smells better than fish.
The taste is spreading through the water.

lines.zh: 把肉丢在水边，然后走开。
lines.en: Drop the meat at the water's edge, then walk away.

lines.zh: 你撞在我背上，像撞湿木头。
lines.en: You hit my back like hitting wet timber.
I didn't move; the mud did.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边蹭过去，皮很粗。
lines.en: I brush past your leg; my hide is rough.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我半边身子上岸了。
lines.en: That shove put half of me on the bank.
I shift aside, laboriously.
You slipped in the mud.

lines.zh: 我们挤在岸边，都不方便。
lines.en: We're crowded at the bank — bad for both.
My hide is coarse and it scrapes.
I've retreated into the water.
I stop and wait for you to go.

lines.zh: 她也浮在这里，只露着眼睛。
lines.en: She floats here too, only her eyes showing.
I ease toward her through the water.

lines.zh: 她靠过来，水面晃了一晃。
lines.en: She comes close and the water rocks once.
I open my jaws; so does she.
This swamp is enough for both of us.
We haul ourselves onto the mud bank.
She rests her head against my neck.
The water reflects the two of us.

lines.zh: 我用下巴蹭了蹭她的头。
lines.en: I rub her head with my jaw.
This season will be quiet.
The fish slaps twice inside my jaws.

lines.zh: 东西掉进水里，我沉下去找。
lines.en: It fell in the water; I sink to look.
I clamp down and drag it onto the mudflat.
I crunch this bone up.

lines.zh: 我张合了几下嘴，才把它咽下。
lines.en: I work my jaws a few times before swallowing.

lines.zh: 我喉咙鼓了一下，就没了。
lines.en: My throat bulges once and it's gone.
I nudge it aside with my snout.
This stone isn't food.

lines.zh: 我把它压在水底的泥里。
lines.en: I press it into the bottom mud.

lines.zh: 我嚼了两下，什么味道都没有。
lines.en: Two chews and there's no taste at all.
The grass on the bank stirred.
I sink my body into the water.
Only my eyes are still above.
It's too close to the water.
I sweep my tail slowly.
Those four legs are too close to the water.
It's too near the water to get away.
I coil my tail to spring.
It's reaching toward the water.

lines.zh: 岸边的草在动，我看见了。
lines.en: The grass on the bank moves. I see it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢漂，跟着它的影子。
lines.en: I drift slowly, tracing its shadow.

lines.zh: 它在岸上走，我在水里并着。
lines.en: It walks the bank; I keep pace in the water.
I sink even lower.
Only when it moves do I move.

lines.zh: 我一半身子泡在水里，不动。
lines.en: Half of me sits in the water, still.
It's started drinking.

lines.zh: 这一段岸很矮，我能上去。
lines.en: The bank's low here; I can get up it.
It suspects nothing.
I've pressed the mud firm underfoot.
It's brought its face to the water.
I whip my head up.
My teeth lock and I drag downward.
I haul it into the water.
I hold on and roll it into deeper water.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，把它按在泥里。
lines.en: I roll and pin it in the mud.
I whip my head and drag it down the mud slope.
That bite made the bone crack.
I jerk my head and tear a piece loose.

lines.zh: 我咬着不放，直到它软了。
lines.en: I hold until it goes limp.
I withdraw slowly into the water.

lines.zh: 泥水顺着我的背淌下去。
lines.en: Muddy water runs down my back.

lines.zh: 我从泥里拱出来，先喘口气。
lines.en: I push up out of the mud and take a first breath.
Reeds and shallows everywhere.
I sink my body down.
I leave only my eyes at the surface.
There's a dry bank up there.
I swim toward it.
A thin mist floats on the water.

lines.zh: 我从浮木底下浮了出来。
lines.en: I rise from under the driftwood.
Sun lies on the water.

lines.zh: 我从泥里拱出来，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I push up out of the mud with only my eyes showing.

lines.zh: 水边有一条被踩出来的路。
lines.en: A trodden path runs along the water's edge.

lines.zh: 皮上的火烧得我往水里冲。
lines.en: Fire on my hide drives me into the water.

lines.zh: 我从岸上掉下来，砸在泥里。
lines.en: I fall off the bank and hit the mud.

lines.zh: 水灌进我嘴里，我挣不开。
lines.en: Water floods my jaws and I can't break free.
The blast throws me up onto the bank.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我背上的硬皮。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the hard hide of my back.
Something churns inside me.

lines.zh: 太久没咬到东西，我瘦了。
lines.en: Too long without a kill; I've thinned.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水面打下来，我僵住了。
lines.en: Lightning comes down the water and I lock up.
The water has no bottom; I sink.
